code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, low total protein, and elevated INR, suggesting impaired oxygenation, possible bone marrow suppression, and coagulopathy. Elevated CRP, ferritin, alkaline phosphatase, and mild monocytosis/basophilia indicate significant inflammation and possible liver involvement. These findings are concerning for severe systemic illness (e.g., infection, sepsis, or inflammatory disease) and warrant urgent clinical evaluation and further investigation.
